author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಹುಟ್ಟು ಸಾವಿನಾಯ್ಕೆ ನಿನ್ನ ಪರಿಧಿಯಲಿಲ್ಲ
ಗುಟ್ಟದುವೆ ತಿಳಿಯದಿಹ ಜೀವನರಹಸ್ಯ
ತೊಟ್ಟಿರುವ ನಿನವೇಷ ಸೂತ್ರಿಕನ ನಿರ್ಧಾರ
ಬಿಟ್ಟಿ ಮೆರೆಯಲುಬೇಡ ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: The choice of birth and death is not within your reach;
that is the secret of life, which no one knows;
the costume you wear is the stage-director’s decision;
don’t show off for nothing, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: We choose neither our birth nor our death; the role we play is assigned by the Director. There is nothing to be proud of.
